summary: Frontend-only verification of AlizceTV restoration (TopBar restored, IPTV moved into streaming grid, focus-overlap reduced). All 10 requested checks pass on preview URL.
verified_checks: TopBar renders full-width with brand-logo (logo.svg + 'ALIZCETV' gradient title + 'LIVING ROOM EDITION' subtitle), center network-status pill ('192.168.1.200 · CONECTADO'), right clock HH:MM:SS + date + settings gear.
Settings dropdown opens on gear click and shows all four options: Ajustes, Ver escritorio, Cerrar AlizceTV, Apagar PC (plus demo-web notice).

Streaming grid uses classes 'grid grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-5 lg:grid-cols-10' and renders exactly 10 tiles: netflix, prime, disney, hbo, movistar, apple, youtube, twitch, filmin, iptv (IPTV is 10th, amber with Radio icon).
No IPTV banner/section exists outside the streaming grid (DOM scan for stray 'IPTV' text outside section-streaming returned empty).
Clicking tile-iptv navigates to /#/iptv and IPTV page renders Directos screen with TopBar visible.
Hover focus on Netflix tile: width grew from 162.8px to 167.97px (~scale 1.03) with 17.4px remaining margin to next tile — no overlap with neighbor (gap was 20px, consumed ~2.6px per side).
Settings menu -> Ajustes navigates to /#/settings; TopBar persists on sub-pages.
No console errors observed during flow.
critical_code_review_comments: TopBar: Escape key does not close the system menu dropdown — only outside mousedown closes it. Minor UX nit.

StreamingGrid: IPTV tile 'label' uses only the short 'IPTV' text (no secondary label like other tiles have via p.label). Visually consistent but asymmetric vs. mapped platforms — acceptable since it's a navigation tile, not a platform launch.
YouTube ad-block via Piped frontend cannot be verified in web preview (platformService.launch is mocked when window.alizce is undefined). Needs Electron-side verification by main agent/user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All visual/structure/navigation assertions from the review request were verified via Playwright DOM inspection on the public preview. Focus-overlap verified numerically: scale 1.03 on 162.8px tile => +5px growth, 20px grid gap preserves 17.4px separation. YouTube/Piped ad-block behavior is Electron-only and cannot be tested in web preview.
